topPRs.title: feat(notifications): real remote push (APNs/FCM) end-to-end + client token registration (#13537)
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes #13537.

## What
Makes the notification remote-push path a **live** pipeline. The server-side APNs/FCM stack (`NotificationPushService`, `ApnsProvider`, `FcmProvider`, `PushTokenRegistry`, `/api/notifications/push-tokens` routes) was already built but **dead**: no client ever registered a device token, so `PushTokenRegistry.list()` was always empty and `onNotification` returned early every time (rule-10: endpoint with no client trigger).

This PR adds the missing client leg and proves the loop end-to-end:

- `ElizaClient.registerPushToken(platform, token)` / `unregisterPushToken(token)` (`packages/ui/src/api/client-notifications.ts`) — the real client trigger for the push-token routes.
- `packages/ui/src/state/notifications/push-registration.ts` — acquires the OS remote token via `@capacitor/push-notifications` `register()` + `registration` listener and POSTs it, gated on a **granted** notification permission (native-only; no-op on web/desktop). Tapped pushes deep-link through the same scheme-checked `navigateDeepLink` as the in-app center.
- Extended `PushNotificationsPluginLike` (`native-plugins.ts`) with the real `register` / `addListener` / `removeAllListeners` surface.
- Registration fires after permission grant; wired into `NotificationsShellBoot` (`notifications-boot.tsx`).
- `packages/agent/src/services/push/README.md` — credentials + wiring doc for the whole stack.

## Evidence

| Type | Path / result |
| --- | --- |
| Integration (real path) | `packages/agent/src/services/push/push-registration-flow.test.ts` — token POSTed through the **real HTTP route** reaches provider `send()` on an emitted notification. ✅ 1 passed (vitest) |
| Unit — client + listener | `packages/ui/src/state/notifications/push-registration.test.ts`, `packages/ui/src/api/client-notifications.test.ts`, `packages/ui/src/platform/mobile-permissions-client.test.ts` — ✅ 25 passed (vitest) |
| Server unit | `apns-provider.test.ts` / `fcm-provider.test.ts` / `notification-push-service.test.ts` / `push-token-registry.test.ts` (this dir) |
| Desktop screenshot | `.github/issue-evidence/13537-notifications-center-desktop.png` (opened & reviewed — dark theme, no blue, accent-only) |
| Mobile screenshot | `.github/issue-evidence/13537-notifications-center-mobile.png` |
| Live network test | `packages/agent/src/services/push/push-delivery.real.test.ts` — armed in the post-merge lane when `ELIZA_APNS_*` / `ELIZA_FCM_*` creds are set; asserts a bogus token is rejected end-to-end against Apple/Google real servers. Registered in `packages/scripts/lib/real-live-suites.mjs`. |
| Real-LLM trajectory | N/A — no agent/model/prompt behavior change; this is transport plumbing. |

### Pending-hardware (code path shipped + exercised to the boundary)
- **Delivery to a physical backgrounded/killed device** (APNs/FCM → real enrolled device) requires live APNs `.p8` / FCM service-account credentials **and** a physical iOS/Android device. The full code path is shipped and exercised up to the network boundary (bogus-token rejection in the live test); on-device delivery is **pending-hardware**.
- **FCM token mint on Android** additionally needs `google-services.json` at build time (documented in the README).

topPRs.body:
Closes #13536.

Surfaces real orchestrator/task/sub-agent/workflow/todo activity **inline in the chat thread** as it happens (Codex/Claude-Code/OpenCode-style pipelining), driven by the existing `pty-session-event` WS stream — **no second scheduler, no new poll for data already on the stream**.

- **Real WS path (no mock)**: `task-activity-store.test.ts` binds the store to the socket then delivers a genuine server `pty-session-event` frame through the real client fan-out → `bindWs` → `toSwarmActivity` → reducer → grouped tree.
